name: Tenma Sukuna
source:
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.

Is a man with chaotic personality and loves to disturb others, much to the annoyance of every Tenmas. 

[spoiler]It was due to his Apoptosis nature that opposed with Yato, Sukuna is not affected by his hatred.[/spoiler]

"The only reason that you guys can set your foot here, was because this town is as good as dead."

[spoiler]In truth he is the combination of [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url]'s best friend and his partner in [url=https://vndb.org/v548#main]Dies Irae[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c29002]Shirou Yusa[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c29003]Honjou Erii[/url], after the death of [url=https://vndb.org/c29001]Marie[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], he along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in order to protect what's left of her world. However, he secretly works with [url=https://vndb.org/c34804]Mikado Ryuumei[/url] in order to find a way to overthrow [url=https://vndb.org/c34838]Hajun[/url].[/spoiler]
